name: product-team
description: A coordinated product team as 27 skills: 19 role perspectives (product, research, design, engineering, delivery) plus an 8-skill delivery pipeline that classifies work by size and verifies each chunk. Use when work needs a specific discipline's judgement — a PRD, a component spec, an accessibility review, a threat model, a motion spec, a release decision — or when a coding task should run through scoped execution with gate checks.
